question: Approve this seed as the backlog baseline: refresh the pi-live lane pins to the Pi 1.0 family and replace the two hardcoded TypeScript source assertions with manifest-derived ones?

artifacts.summary: The pi-live Runtime Live E2E lane pins pi-coding-agent 0.85.1, pi-subagents 0.67.0, and pi-intercom 0.13.0; the current published family is 1.0.0 / 0.75.0 / 0.16.0. The lane also asserts pi-subagents ships src/extension/index.ts and src/intercom/intercom-bridge.ts, which no longer exist, so the pin bump alone reds the lane. Local evidence: pi 1.0.0 reports OK on the launcher floor 0.83.0 and on every other pi doctor check; only the two stale .ts probes fail, and those belong to mc. Scope is the lane pins, their integritys, the manifest-derived assertions, and docs/runtime-live-ci.md. Out of scope: internal/cli/pi.go probe resolution (mc), the node runtime bump (3g8), the claude/codex lane pins.
